sections.title: A fan project, made for the music
sections.body: RESCENE Rhythm is an unofficial, fan-made, nonprofit game. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by RESCENE, its members, label or other rights holders. Music, photographs, names and other third-party material remain the property of their respective owners. Fan-made status does not grant us ownership of that material.

sections.title: Free to play. Watch out for scams.
sections.body: The project is provided for fan enjoyment, not for profit. Anyone offering to sell you game accounts, cards, items, Starlight or access for real money or cryptocurrency is most likely a scammer. We do not authorize those sales. Do not pay them. Use only links published on rhythm.remineph.online and remineph.online. Report suspicious players using the in-game Report action or email winterape25@gmail.com.

sections.title: In-game items are for gameplay
sections.body: The game's marketplace uses in-game Starlight. Cards, rewards, wallets and blockchain features are gameplay features, not an investment or a promise of monetary value, earnings or cash redemption. Do not purchase tokens from third parties to use this game. Test features, balances and item availability may change. Review any displayed confirmation before consuming or sacrificing an item; those actions may be permanent.

sections.title: Your account and our community
sections.body: Keep your password and recovery codes private. Do not impersonate others, harass players, upload unlawful content, scam, cheat, exploit bugs or interfere with the service. Upload only images you have permission to share. We may remove harmful content or restrict accounts that abuse the service. Report abuse through the in-game reporting tools.

sections.title: Availability and changes
sections.body: This is a developing fan project. Features may be changed, interrupted or withdrawn, and availability or preservation of progress is not guaranteed. We may update these documents; the displayed version and date identify the text accepted when your account was created. Nothing here removes rights that applicable law gives you.

sections.title: Questions and rights-holder requests
sections.body: Contact the project team at winterape25@gmail.com for questions, scam reports or rights-holder concerns. By checking the registration agreement, you agree to these Terms & Conditions and acknowledge that you have read the Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Who handles your information
sections.body: The RESCENE Rhythm fan-project team operates the game and its companion website. Contact: winterape25@gmail.com. This notice describes the information used to provide your account, gameplay and community features.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: We store your username, account identifier, account creation time, a password hash, login-session records and the version and time of your registration agreement. If you use the relevant features, we also store your profile picture and gallery uploads, gameplay results and progression, cards and inventory, wallet address and transaction records, follows, presence, messages, reports and moderation records. Network requests can include IP addresses and technical information used by the server and hosting providers for delivery, security and troubleshooting.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.body: We use this information to create and secure your account, keep you signed in, save progress and results, deliver rewards and items, provide social features, prevent cheating and scams, moderate abuse and answer requests. The agreement checkbox is not permission for unrelated advertising or marketing.

sections.title: What others can see
sections.body: Your public player name, profile media, records and social information can be visible to other players through the game's features. Direct messages are available to their participants and may be accessed for moderation, reports or support. Authorized project administrators can access records needed to operate and protect the service. Hosting, storage and wallet/blockchain service providers process relevant information to deliver these features. Blockchain wallet addresses and transactions may be public, copied by others and difficult or impossible to erase.

sections.title: Information on your device
sections.body: The app stores login tokens and settings on your device so you can stay signed in and keep your preferences. The website uses its session storage mechanisms to keep you signed in. Signing out clears the locally stored login session; it does not delete your server account. Protect access to your device and never share session files or recovery codes.

sections.title: Retention and your choices
sections.body: Account, gameplay and community records persist on our servers; uninstalling the app does not remove them. You can edit supported profile information and remove uploaded pictures through the game. Email winterape25@gmail.com to request access, correction, export or deletion of your account information, or to raise a privacy concern. We may ask you to verify account ownership and explain any information that must remain for security, disputes or applicable obligations. Copies may remain temporarily in backups; public blockchain records cannot generally be deleted. Applicable privacy rights and any available complaint process are not limited by this notice.

sections.title: Updates to this notice
sections.body: The date and version shown here identify this notice. If our data practices change, we will update it. Questions and account-data requests should be sent to winterape25@gmail.com.
